verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents that its Create Event endpoint can create a new profile or update an existing profile's properties. Its schemaless data model accepts arbitrary custom properties without pre-configuration. Rate-limit headers, Retry-After handling, OAuth with improved rate limits and server-side SDKs support production-scale use. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to suppress or unsubscribe contacts through the API. Nor is there a dedicated profile create/update endpoint or bulk import capability. missing for 10: documented profile suppression/unsubscribe API, dedicated profile CRUD and bulk import endpoints, concrete throughput limits, independent hands-on corroboration at scale
